profile.summary: HealGaren is a Mid-Level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in URL handling and HTTP standards compliance, demonstrated through contributions to the Axios library. Their work focuses on low-level adjustments to URL encoding logic, RFC 3986 adherence, and debugging test environment quirks. While primarily contributing to backend HTTP client functionality, their contributions reflect deep understanding of JavaScript runtime behavior and library internals. Evidence suggests familiarity with Node.js and browser environments, as well as technical writing skills for explaining complex standards-based decisions. No frontend framework experience is visible in the PR data, but their skills are highly transferable to other JavaScript libraries or backend systems.

Version Control & Code Maintenance: PR Re-creation Due to Major Changes
